1.consolidated_definition: Fantasear sexualmente con alguien o algo. ¿Hacer ‘cerebrito’ es pegárselas a tu pareja? (Usuario de Facebook, 19-7-13)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To fantasize sexually about someone or something. To "make a cerebrito" of one's partner (a colloquialism referring to impressing or trying to seduce one's romantic partner).
